newsitem.title: USA: O&R ends gas marketing, sees more costs.
newsitem.headline: O&R ends gas marketing, sees more costs.

text.p: Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc said Tuesday it has tentatively agreed to end the operations of NORSTAR Energy LP natural gas services and marketing operation, adding this is expected to cost the company $0.50 per share in addition to NORSTAR's $0.33 loss in the first quarter.
The utility said its NORSTAR Management Inc subsidiary has signed a letter of intent to sell certain NORSTAR Energy LP assets to UGI Corp's UGI Energy Services Inc.
NORSTAR Management, the general partner of the partnership, will then wind up the remaining portion of the partnership business, Orange and Rockland said.

It said write-downs of certain NORSTAR assets and assumption of certain NORSTAR liabilities, along with wind up costs and additional operating losses in the second quarter, are expected to further reduce second quarter results by an estimated $0.50 per share.

"Despite some profitable periods in the past, changing market conditions have made it clear that NORSTAR's future profitability would require greater scale and backoffice expertise than it could bring to bear in the short-term," chief executive D. Louis Peoples explained.
